basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a 25-year-old from a small town in the Midwest, currently working as a junior graphic designer. I recently moved to a bustling city to start fresh and explore new opportunities. In my free time, I enjoy learning about homemaking tips, which led me to the subreddit. I'm single and love spending evenings exploring local cafes or curling up with a good book. I'm usually online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and am passionate about digital art. Most of my knowledge comes from college courses and online tutorials. I'm also self-teaching myself about home economics and personal finance.
